name: Leads from Meta/Google Ads
description: Starts by pinning down who you sell to and proposing niches, then mines Meta's Ad Library and Google's Ads Transparency Center for B2B prospects, adding phone numbers from official sources. Only reaches companies that advertise on those two platforms, which shapes the kind of list you end up with.
